title: Proposal Refinement Reason
description: Machine-readable reason a proposal revision was only partially applied or could not be produced.

enumDescriptions.commercially_declined: The seller understood terms requested through the free-text ask but declined to offer them. An unmet typed constraint or product change always uses constraint_unsatisfiable instead, whether the seller cannot or will not meet it.
enumDescriptions.constraint_unsatisfiable: One or more typed hard constraints or product changes were not satisfied. Takes precedence over every other code when failures co-occur.
enumDescriptions.unsupported_dimension: The seller cannot parse or validate one or more typed refinement dimensions used by the request.
enumDescriptions.uninterpreted: The seller could not interpret some or all of the free-text ask.
enumDescriptions.alternatives_unavailable: The seller produced fewer distinct draft alternatives than requested.
enumDescriptions.source_unavailable: The source proposal was not found, visible, or eligible for revision by this caller.
enumDescriptions.hold_unavailable: The seller declined or failed to reserve inventory for this finalize entry, or declined to extend the hold on this extend_hold entry, whether from sell-through since drafting, from hold policy such as a concurrent-hold cap or an extension limit (the committed proposal's hold_policy.extendable is false or absent, or no later expires_at fits within hold_placed_at plus hold_policy.max_total_duration), or because it cannot honor the draft's hold_policy.min_duration (including before an installment booking deadline or change cutoff). A failed extend_hold leaves the source proposal and its hold unchanged. Valid only for an entry whose effective policy holds inventory; a seller MUST NOT return it for an entry whose effective policy is terms-only: a draft whose hold_policy.available is false, or a draft without hold_policy at a seller declaring hold_semantics terms_only in get_adcp_capabilities. An extend_hold against a committed proposal that holds no inventory fails at task level with INVALID_STATE instead.
enumDescriptions.batch_aborted: This entry failed only because a sibling entry in the all-or-none finalize or extend_hold batch failed; the entry itself was otherwise eligible. An entry whose effective policy is terms-only returns it when a sibling failed for a non-hold reason or, in a batch that also contains holdable entries, when a holdable sibling returned hold_unavailable. When every entry in the batch is terms-only, no sibling can fail for a hold reason.
